sync_provider.title: File Explorer sync notifications
sync_provider.description: Turns off promotional notifications from providers like OneDrive in File Explorer.

lockscreen_tips.title: Lock screen tips and fun facts
lockscreen_tips.description: Turns off suggestions, tips and promotions shown on the lock screen.

settings_suggestions.title: Suggested content in Settings
settings_suggestions.description: Turns off suggestion cards on the Settings home page.

windows_tips.title: Windows usage tips
windows_tips.description: Turns off suggestions and tips shown while using Windows.

scoobe.title: Setup completion suggestions
scoobe.description: Turns off 'Get the most out of your device' suggestions.

welcome_experience.title: Post-update welcome experience
welcome_experience.description: Turns off the 'what's new' screen shown after updates.

advertising_id.title: Advertising ID
advertising_id.description: Prevents apps from using your advertising ID for personalized ads.

tailored_experiences.title: Tailored experiences
tailored_experiences.description: Turns off suggestions personalized from diagnostic data.

start_recommendations.title: Start menu recommendations
start_recommendations.description: Turns off 'recommended' app and tip cards in the Start menu.

smart_optout.title: Unused app notifications
smart_optout.description: Turns off 'you haven't opened these apps in a while' style suggestions.

bing_search.title: Bing results in Search
bing_search.description: Turns off web/Bing results in Windows Search (policy key).

edge_widget.title: Edge desktop search widget
edge_widget.description: Turns off the desktop search widget opened by Edge (policy key).
